title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Consumer Civil Public Interest Litigation Cases

articles.content_en:
Article 1 Where the China Consumers Association and the consumers associations established in provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government initiate consumer civil public interest litigation against business operators for conduct that infringes upon the lawful rights and interests of many unspecified consumers or that endangers the personal or property safety of consumers, thereby harming the public interest, this Interpretation shall apply.
Consumer civil public interest litigation initiated by organs and social organizations as provided by law or authorized by the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee shall be governed by this Interpretation.

Article 3 The jurisdiction over consumer civil public interest litigation cases shall be governed by the relevant provisions of Article 285 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.
With the approval of the Supreme People's Court, a Higher People's Court may, according to the actual circumstances of its jurisdiction, designate some Intermediate People's Courts within its jurisdiction to accept first-instance consumer civil public interest litigation cases.

Article 5 Where the People's Court considers that the claims proposed by the plaintiff are insufficient to protect the social public interest, it may explain to the plaintiff that it may modify or add claims such as cessation of infringement.

Article 6 After the People's Court accepts a consumer civil public interest litigation case, it shall publicly announce the acceptance of the case and shall, within ten days from the date of filing the case, notify in writing the relevant administrative department.

Article 7 After the People's Court accepts a consumer civil public interest litigation case, other organs or social organizations that may initiate litigation according to law may apply to the People's Court to participate in the proceedings before the first-instance court session.
If the People's Court permits participation in the proceedings, they shall be listed as co-plaintiffs; if the application is made after the time limit, permission shall not be granted.
Article 8 Organs or social organizations entitled to initiate consumer civil public interest litigation may, pursuant to Article 81 of the Civil Procedure Law, apply for preservation of evidence.

Article 9 After the People's Court accepts a consumer civil public interest litigation case, where consumers who have suffered damage due to the same tortious act apply to participate in the proceedings, the People's Court shall notify them to assert their rights in accordance with Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law.

Article 10 After a consumer civil public interest litigation case is accepted, where consumers who have suffered damage due to the same tortious act request a stay of the action they have brought in accordance with Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law, the People's Court may permit it.
Article 11 During the trial of a consumer civil public interest litigation case, if the defendant files a counterclaim, the People's Court shall not accept it.
Article 12 Where the plaintiff admits in the litigation facts unfavorable to itself, and the People's Court considers that this harms the social public interest, it shall not confirm such admission.

Article 13 Where the plaintiff in a consumer civil public interest litigation case requests the defendant to bear civil liability such as cessation of infringement, removal of obstruction, elimination of danger, and making an apology, the People's Court may support it.
Where a business operator, by using standard terms or notices, declarations, in-store announcements, etc., excludes or restricts consumers' rights, reduces or exempts the business operator's liabilities, or increases consumers' liabilities, and the plaintiff claims that such provisions are unfair, unreasonable, and invalid, the People's Court shall support the claim according to law.

Article 14 After the judgment or ruling in a consumer civil public interest litigation case takes effect, the People's Court shall, within ten days, notify the relevant administrative department in writing, and may issue a judicial suggestion.

Article 15 After the judgment or ruling in a consumer civil public interest litigation case becomes legally effective, where other organs or social organizations that have plaintiff qualification according to law separately initiate consumer civil public interest litigation against the same tortious act, the People's Court shall not accept it.

Article 16 Facts already ascertained by an effective judgment or ruling in a consumer civil public interest litigation case shall not require proof by either the plaintiff or the defendant in an action brought by consumers who have suffered damage due to the same tortious act in accordance with Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law, unless the parties have objections to such facts and have sufficient contrary evidence to overturn them.
Where an effective judgment or ruling in a consumer civil public interest litigation case ascertains that a business operator has engaged in unlawful conduct, and in an action brought by consumers who have suffered damage due to the same tortious act in accordance with Article 119 of the Civil Procedure Law, the plaintiff claims that such finding shall apply, the People's Court may support it, unless the defendant has sufficient contrary evidence to overturn it. Where the defendant claims direct application of a finding favorable to it, the People's Court shall not support it, and the defendant shall still bear the corresponding burden of proof.

Article 17 Where the plaintiff requests the defendant to bear the expenses incurred for taking reasonable prevention and disposal measures to cease infringement, remove obstruction, and eliminate danger, the People's Court shall support the request according to law.

Article 18 The People's Court may, according to the actual circumstances, provide corresponding support for the reasonable expenses incurred by the plaintiff and its litigation agents in investigating and collecting evidence of the tortious act, expert evaluation fees, and reasonable attorney fees.

Article 19 This Interpretation shall come into force on May 1, 2016.
First-instance cases newly accepted by the People's Court after this Interpretation comes into force shall be governed by this Interpretation.
First-instance and second-instance cases that have been accepted by the People's Court before this Interpretation comes into force and have not been concluded after it comes into force, as well as cases that have been finally adjudicated before this Interpretation comes into force and for which, after it comes into force, the parties apply for retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, shall not be governed by this Interpretation.
